$comment: Story 4.6 (ADR-158): EVACUATE — Karthik's way; Rathore's convoy at the railway station. If you didn't back Karthik at the fire, Rathore takes you and not the others.

panels.title: MAJESTIC · 03:10
panels.text: Up the dead escalators into the railway station. Three olive trucks, engines running, no lights.

panels.title: THE TRUCKS
panels.text: Rathore counts heads. Karthik first, then Uncle, then the rest of you. Nobody is left on the platform.

panels.title: THE TRUCKS
panels.text: Rathore counts heads and stops at you. 'One more seat.' The others are still on the steps when the truck moves.

panels.title: THE TRUCKS
panels.text: Deepa stays at the gate. 'They don't take the bitten.' She says it before anyone else has to.

panels.title: YELAHANKA AIRBASE · DAWN
panels.text: Behind you, the city — purple in patches, then not at all.
